scope: CPU reconstruction of already-run frozen conditions and local measurements of existing paired predictions; zero inference.

units.native: K*abs(q/255-focus), nominal control, not measured blur radius
units.actual: K times abs-before-resize/bilinear-antialias/CenterCrop before Normalize; reconstructed normalized tensors bitwise verified
units.normalized: actual saved encoder input channel0 delta; three channels identical; no K multiplication inside model input
units.output: RGB8 channel levels 0..255; float outputs 0..1; response not quality

limitations: Controls are adjacent comparisons only, never newly designated correction references.
Rectangles may mix shoe/bell/leg/background; full rectangle and target-ID intersection reported separately, neither is object-depth truth.
RGB-only anatomical localization is provisional, user confirms whether boxes match described problem.
Train is DOF-change evidence, not confirmed depth error.
No neural inference, no new condition intervention, no tau/mask changes.
Only representative frames, not a whole-clip temporal diagnosis.
An unchanged local condition can still have output response through nonlocal/spatiotemporal context; not an isolated causal intervention.

B20.observation: 成人左右鞋及不同代表帧覆盖差异大。24帧图像左鞋交集全部触发限幅，实际条件明确变化；右鞋大部分未触发。不能把成人鞋合并解释为未覆盖或修正无效。
B20.next_check: 先由用户确认左右鞋框及原RGB对应细节。左鞋24帧确认后，对照仍保留的名义离焦与已有输出响应，讨论条件利用/边界纹理是否需要后续检查；右鞋先核查原离焦与覆盖。当前不运行编码检查、不降低tau。

B34.observation: 0/12/24帧铃铛核心主体交集均未触发限幅，实际CoC逐值不变。外围混合框可有少量变化，不能代表铃铛核心已被修改。
B34.next_check: 先确认铃铛核心及颈部比较框。位置成立后，比较原RGB与输出、原离焦和颈部差异；先讨论原名义离焦是否符合期望，不能称已修但无效，也不据此直接降低全局tau或确认深度错误。

train.observation: 末节车厢核心候选在0/6/12帧主体交集全部触发，实际CoC及输出响应明显大于本次鞋/铃铛候选。

case_summaries.evidence_boundary: 位置均待用户确认；只覆盖所列代表帧。全主体其他位置也被V2修改，局部输出响应不是隔离因果实验，不将直接响应大小解释为质量或真实深度正确性。
